text: The Art of Sport Ultra Strength Recovery Cream is not unscented [S1, S2, S3, S4]. Reviewers describe its smell as resembling wintergreen or having a menthol scent that is not overwhelming, though one reviewer compared the strong odor to traditional products used by elderly grandparents [S1, S2, S3, S4]. While some users enjoy the scent or receive compliments on a nice odor, others find the smell unpleasant [S1, S3, S4].
